prayerExcerpt.en-US: "Blessed are the servants whom the Lord at His coming shall find watching."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Bem-aventurados os servos que o Senhor, ao chegar, encontrar vigilantes."

meta.face: A Roman of about seventy with a warm olive complexion and a BROAD-JAWED, heavy-boned head whose centre is a MASSIVE, HOOKED Roman nose — a LOW, heavy BROW RIDGE with thick, STRAIGHT white brows in one level line, small, bright, deep-set dark eyes, flat cheeks cut by deep vertical creases, a thin, firm, straight mouth; short white hair combed forward; a SHORT, crisp, tightly CURLED white beard close to the jaw; the gaze vigilant, straight toward us.
meta.basis: No likeness from life; Wikipedia's lead image is a modern window at Dundalk. The book tells his condemnation of Nestorius and his sending Germanus to Britain and Palladius to the Scots; Wikipedia: he established the cardinal title of Santa Sabina in 423, whose doors date from his reign or his successor's. The beard and the heavy, hook-nosed face are our choice, apart from the clean-shaven `simplicius`.
